provenance.method: one RTL capture of every unit's ports (the SoC's RTL, the surgered core below XSTile), each unit's global-route netlist replayed alone from it and checked against it every clock phase, the replays' SAIFs merged, one report_power per unit on its own global-route ODB, summed
notes: every two-level piece counted, not stopped: its output differences from the RTL are in replays.outputs_differing

dynamic power at the SDC period, 1,800 ps, which the capture was timed against; the period of the design is 2,377 ps, set by the parent (reg2reg WNS -577 ps), a finding of this build: derived has the energy per cycle and the power at 2,377 ps
cycles is the whole run the capture traced, reset to halt; the power is averaged over saif_window_ps alone, the last CoreMark iteration, 120,389 cycles at the SDC period
